Overview

Haifa is a city in Haifa with a population of 285,000. A major port city on Mount Carmel, known for the Baha’i Gardens, its tech industry, and Jewish-Arab coexistence. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
